jobs.occupation: Senior Power BI Developer – Power Platform & Data Analytics
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

• Design and build complex Power BI dashboards to support supply chain teams and project stakeholders.
• Integrate and structure data from multiple sources using Power Apps and Power Automate to create scalable reporting workflows.
• Diagnose and resolve performance, data-quality, and integration issues within the existing dashboard landscape.
• Collaborate with business users to translate reporting needs into technical requirements and validated data solutions.
• Apply Lean Six Sigma methodologies to analyze warehouse processes and perform root-cause analysis for operational improvement.
• Support the implementation of AI-enabled solutions to enhance data analysis and team productivity.
• Maintain compliance with GxP, data governance, and safety standards within a regulated environment.

Requirements

• You bring 8+ years of experience in Power BI development, including dashboard design, data modeling, and performance optimization.
• You have 5+ years of experience in dashboard lifecycle management and troubleshooting complex data integration problems.
• You possess 3+ years of professional experience applying AI-enabled solutions to improve data reporting and analysis.
• You have practical experience using Power Apps and Power Automate to support business process automation.
• You bring a sound understanding of warehousing, inventory management, and material planning operations.
• You possess a working knowledge of Lean Six Sigma principles and tools for variation and root-cause analysis.
• You have a Master’s degree in Science, Supply Chain, Data Analytics, or a related field.
• You're analytical and tech-savvy, with a structured problem-solving mindset and high attention to detail.
• You are fluent in English.
Nice to Haves

• Experience in a biotechnology, pharmaceutical, or other GxP regulated environment.
• Possession of a Lean Six Sigma certification.
• Experience contributing to operational excellence projects in warehouse or production environments.
• Knowledge of Dutch or French.

jobs.occupation: Senior Full Stack Developer – Python & Google Cloud Platform
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

• Lead the technical build of APIs, data platforms, and overall application architecture in collaboration with internal stakeholders.
• Act as a senior advisor to define the most effective technologies, tools, and architectures for various projects.
• Deploy best practices systematically to ensure sustainable scalability and high-quality modular code.
• Develop and maintain Python-based web services and robust CI/CD pipelines.
• Implement AI-based regression testing and provide technical insights for business analysis.
• Automate internal tasks and create custom technical solutions for risk and data analytics teams.

Requirements

• You have 8+ years of backend development experience with Python, FastAPI, Celery, SQLModel, and Pydantic.
• You possess 8+ years of experience with Google Cloud Platform, including GKE, Compute Engine, BigQuery, and Cloud SQL.
• You bring 8+ years of expertise in DevOps and CI/CD using Kubernetes, ArgoCD, Helm, Docker, and GitLab CI/CD.
• You have extensive experience with data and integration tools such as PostgreSQL, SQLAlchemy, and Alembic.
• You possess deep knowledge of security and identity management including JWT, IAM, and Secret Manager.
• You have experience with REST APIs and the programmatical usage of AI models like Vertex AI or Pydantic AI.
• You're experienced in Linux system administration, Nginx, VPC networking, and Wireguard.
• You're a structured self-starter with a proactive approach and a high level of professional integrity.
• You are fluent in English.
Nice to Haves

• Experience with frontend development using TypeScript, Next.js, and NPM.
• Knowledge of Wordpress administration and theme development.
• Experience with data architecture or a background in B2B trade.
• Active knowledge of Dutch or French.

jobs.occupation: Kitchen Help Industrial Kitchen - Aalter - 2 Shifts
jobs.description:
Vol-au-vent, tomato soup with meatballs, or a perfectly cooked roast beef: you’ll be licking your fingers and thumbs. And in this role, you’ll make sure others can do the same. In our kitchen, we create dishes that would make grandmothers jealous—but on an industrial scale, in large quantities.
 

We’re looking for a Kitchen Help for a food company in Aalter!
 

Hygiene is crucial for a kitchen staff member. That’s why you’ll ensure every day that your work methods and the final products meet all standards.
 

You’ll also follow safety regulations to the letter. You’ll do everything in your power to guarantee both quality and safety. 
 

 

Who are you?

• You have experience as a cook in a commercial or industrial kitchen. Do you also have experience in a production environment? If so, that’s a plus.
• You are able and willing to work in a rotating two-shift system.
• The early shift starts at 4:30 a.m. and runs until 12:30 p.m.
• The late shift starts at 12:45 p.m. and runs until 8:00 p.m.
• You know how to operate machinery or are willing to undergo training for this.
• Physical work doesn’t deter you, and you’re hands-on.
• You work with great precision and are flexible and able to handle stress.
• You’re a good communicator, enjoy variety, and like working in a team.
• You speak Dutch or English well.

A growing company that provides bespoke packaging and storage services for frozen and chilled food products for European customers. By 2027, the company aims to have over 300 employees working together on 25,000 unique packaging orders. You'll work in a respectful environment where teamwork and job satisfaction are key.

For a client in the Roeselare region, within the food sector, Let's Work is looking for an experienced forklift operator for day shifts.

Your main responsibilities will include the safe handling and storage of goods, operating the forklift to a height of up to 8 metres and ensuring a smooth flow of goods to the packaging department. On top of that, you can count on a starting wage of €15.23 per hour, meal vouchers worth €7 per day and attractive working hours from 8.00 am to 4.30 pm.

You'll spend most of your day (±90%) operating the forklift

 
• 
You'll be placing octabins and pallets at heights of up to 8 metres in the warehouse

 
• 
You'll be responsible for delivering products to be packaged to the packaging department

 
• 
You scan labels and locations correctly into the system

 
• 
During your work, you ensure a smooth and organised flow of goods

 
• 
You hold a valid forklift certificate

 
• 
You have at least 2 years' experience as a forklift operator, including working at height

 
• 
You communicate fluently in English to work effectively with colleagues

 
• 
Working in a cold environment (deep-freeze), using a heated forklift truck, is in line with your expectations

 
• 
Working accurately and respecting safety are second nature to you
